text: Within the MCP Tool Collection, the pipeline identifies the Correct Tools labeled G.
Alongside these, Distractor Tools labeled F are introduced.
Together, they are merged into the Candidate Tool List L containing K tools, which is provided to the sandbox.
In parallel, the Task Set supplies Real-world Tasks into the environment.
These inputs enter the AutoGen-based Sandbox.
The sandbox handles Dynamic MCP Tool Loading,
and maintains Stable and Reproducible Execution.
The sandbox exchanges tool calls and execution feedback with the LLM-based Agent.
